a: Swift time plus NASA funding for US investigators
dt: Phase-1 proposals due Jan 28, 2027 via ARK/RPS (ROSES-25 Amendment 80, posted Oct 20, 2026); Cycle 23 starts about Jul 1, 2027
e: NASA's Swift Guest Investigator Cycle 23 call for archival data analysis, theory, correlative investigations and new GRB projects. Open to all; NASA funding goes only to US investigators.
unv: Amendment 80 solicits archival, theoretical and correlative proposals and new GRB projects; it does not mention new Swift observing time, so the row is listed as a research grant rather than observing time. Time of day not checked on NSPIRES.
